method: blind: X = DeepCache off (server --engine-arg deepcache=0, the effective behaviour before per-stream DeepCache), Y = per-stream DeepCache (7240b54a); walking filmstrips, 8 frames 0.15 s apart, all 8 zones, headless WebKit
summary: I'd rather walk through Y [on]: it keeps its landmarks (sconces, windows, relief panel, light slit) and shows far less unpainted geometry, with little loss of detail. The difference is small overall: clear in the atrium and vestibule, slight in the nave, stacks and desert, and negligible in the baths, garden and geode.
